a91d191c-1f1b-44c4-a3c5-f48cbb788c72: In late December 2024, members of The Palm Poetry Society held a year-end gathering at Qinghuazhuang. Their poems celebrate fellowship over wine and winter snow while exploring themes of blue-and-white porcelain aesthetics, painting, philosophy, and chivalric spirit.
57abf71c-9b4f-45f2-83d1-d29c03ca7164: A lecture by Mr. Yuan Lifan on Dream of the Red Chamber and the treasures of the Palace Museum, held by The Palm Poetry Society in September 2026.
3b20613a-9a3d-4923-864e-8eba2dcbbdb1: In August 2023, members of The Palm Poetry Society gathered for an excursion to Niagara Falls and the Niagara whirlpool. Their poems describe the natural scenery of the rushing waters, emerald swirls, and the Rainbow Bridge. The verses also celebrate the fellowship of friends drinking wine, walking in the woods, and sharing discussions on poetry and life.
f8184276-d384-4dc1-98f0-967f8f607f1d: This collection records The Palm Poetry Society's winter and New Year gathering held around January 6, 2024, commemorating a get-together by Lake Qiyun. The featured poems reflect on welcoming the new year, camaraderie, and sharing wine alongside martial sword imagery. They also capture winter snow, artistic reflections, and the passage of time.
0be9dd82-fd7b-431a-9eb6-07d534bac4a4: Nearly thirty members of The Palm Poetry Society held a summer gathering in June 2024 at Juxian Pavilion in Qingcheng Valley. Their poems document the rainy outdoor salon and its lively discussions covering literature, philosophy, and immigrant life. Additional accompanying verses reflect on nature, passing time, personal memories, and contemplation of the universe.
066bcb7d-6457-411b-a062-88960bd00b31: On September 25, 2024, members of The Palm Poetry Society gathered at a member's home near the falls for an autumn barbecue, tea, and an evening campfire. The attendees played a literary game guessing and completing a newly carved pavilion couplet, and they composed verses celebrating autumn nature, the misty waterfall scenery, and warm camaraderie.
dee37085-7ca8-4dae-90d0-1b5972619bd9: On August 14, 2026, members of The Palm Poetry Society held an informal outdoor gathering by Swan Lake in Markham, bringing coffee, tea, and fresh produce. Their poems capture the relaxed lakeside atmosphere and explore themes such as the symbolism of gourds and the rise of artificial intelligence, questioning whether AI can convey genuine human emotion and lived experience. The collection also includes playful classical and modern verses celebrating friendship, nature, and shared laughter.
14e5ae6f-9ac4-400c-92e4-dad8102a4a32: Members of The Palm Poetry Society met at Zijue Jinyan to discuss matters concerning the society's study room. During the gathering, Xu Zhiyuan repeatedly quoted from Li Bai's classic piece 'Letter to Han Jingzhou,' highlighting themes of lofty lifelong ambition and spirit.
a7e5a563-9c9e-496a-a589-a05a63628dd8: This publication represents the inaugural collection of The Palm Poetry Society, featuring original works alongside accompanying literary commentaries. The poems reflect on themes of nature, the passage of time, seasonal transitions, and personal memory, engaging with subjects such as Mount Lu, a North American solar eclipse, and rural life.
31300aff-4b07-4c83-bcaa-e714de63cbff: This record features the poem "Night Lying at Blue Mountain" by Wen Ren, accompanied by a recitation by Haibian. The poem depicts an autumn hike through Blue Mountain, describing scenes of yellow foliage, waterfalls, and a deep pool, followed by peaceful nighttime reflections overlooking the water under the stars.
58a56e95-0f5f-429b-8c82-f917e8f9b358: This feature from the society presents the poem "The Columns" by Fengdong, accompanied by commentary from guest Gushan Meiyu and an English translation by Mayflower. The poem uses imagery of nails driven into time and the ruined columns of the Parthenon to reflect on aging, resistance against bodily decay, and the remnants of history.
4adac7ea-9f42-4cd3-8fd7-eb12d3a35cf8: This feature from The Palm Poetry Society highlights poems by Mo Wang Shan and Gu Tu, alongside English translations by Mayflower. Mo Wang Shan's poems dwell on themes of solitude, stormy love, and an indelible emotional mark left by a glance. Gu Tu's works contemplate spiritual reincarnation, the transition between sacred cultivation and worldly life, and the exploration of multiple selves.
efc9a791-975e-401f-8c90-43ae5dd5f62e: The fifth issue of The Palm Poetry Society features works by members Yang Qing and Haibian. Yang Qing's poems focus on heavenly music heard while soaring among the clouds and the warmth of indoor blooms contrasted with falling snow. Haibian's works portray crystalline ice flowers in the remote frozen north and the arrival of winter snow carrying seeds of renewal.
3fcb95f3-b6a9-4cef-b46b-387c0edba087: Dated August 17–18, 2020, this poetry dialogue presentation features individual poems alongside an on-screen improvised exchange by poets Wang Shan, Feng Dong, and Tao Ran. The verses explore themes of love, loss, and forgiveness, accompanied by philosophical reflections on truth, time, memory, and emotion.
2968bbf8-8e2b-4332-b867-a830448ba436: Dated April 18, 2020, in Toronto, this publication by The Palm Poetry Society features a ci poem written by Wen Ren, set to the tune Shuidiao Getou, accompanied by an appreciation essay by Dan and a vocal rendition by Li Desheng. The poem reflects on leaning against a railing on a moonlit night, searching across time for a kindred spirit, and observing the vastness of heaven and river landscapes. It expresses a philosophical view of life's transient dreams and a longing to retire into nature, surrounded by bamboo, cranes, flute music, and ink paintings.
1d91dd3e-9044-4213-a6e2-a643c66f9789: In September 2020, members of The Palm Poetry Society held a lakeside gathering at Lake Simcoe. Their poems capture the joy of sharing food, wine, and conversation by candlelight after enduring isolation during the pandemic. The verses also celebrate friendship, early autumn scenery, and the view of an orange moon rising over the water.
fea7cb5e-fd42-4941-8623-ca11c5b5c867: This publication presents The Palm Poetry Society's 2020 year-end literary gathering. The featured poems center on themes of winter cold, snow, solitude, and finding warmth through memory, nature, and words. Several pieces also address the ongoing pandemic, contemplating social isolation, an online anti-epidemic benefit performance, and the loss of a young doctor.
579b7f8a-f2b9-4bfc-8b83-e08223ece2e8: On March 28, 2021, members of The Palm Poetry Society held an early spring literary gathering at Wangshan Pavilion. Their poems depict the rainy Sunday get-together, wine drinking, spring landscapes, and gratitude toward their hosts. The verses also reflect on companionship, poetic conversations, and the passage of time.
955e6a5c-ea09-4022-ad0e-e8b7f1492094: On October 27, 2021, members of The Palm Poetry Society held an autumn literary gathering at Edward Garden. Their poems depict the seasonal autumn scenery, highlighting colorful maple leaves, streams, white birds, and the pleasure of gathering with friends.
b65b6198-0a7f-44b7-b9eb-f91ef5215952: This record documents the 2022 High Park Cherry Blossom Gathering, held around Mother's Day in May 2022. The featured poems capture friends gathering to view blooming cherry blossoms and swans, while reflecting on memories of mothers, the transience of life, and thoughts on Shanghai.
3477f7b1-a783-43bc-986a-f5a6f65859da: On July 17, 2022, society members gathered at Jinyuan to celebrate the birthday of Wen Ren. The poems include birthday greetings alongside reflections on garden strolls, drinking by the hearth, the immigrant journey, chivalric ideals, and meditations on nature and time.
486b544e-3fe0-4c75-8016-4535c5038114: Members gathered at Jinyuan in the Renyin year to celebrate Wen Ren's birthday and exchange poetic commentaries on one another's works. Written by Yang Qing in response to poems by fellow society members, the verses reflect on campfire gatherings, wine, nature, and appreciation for a photographer capturing their shared memories.
a10d1f95-7c33-4f07-9710-bc8666bb8dee: On October 21, 2022, members of The Palm Poetry Society gathered for an autumn outing and banquet at the Niagara Falls and Niagara Gorge. Their poems describe the natural scenery of the gorge, cascading waterfalls, rainbows, and colorful autumn foliage, while also celebrating their shared fellowship, hiking, and drinking.
7a03996e-68fb-4fd1-9ea8-70311ab3f8d9: This record documents a poetry relay titled "Beauty Is So Slight" organized by The Palm Poetry Society in January 2025 around the New Year. Written using variations of a shared phrasing pattern, the poems reflect on the delicacy of beauty, natural imagery, everyday hardships, divine grace, and human longing.
615aeca4-296c-44dd-8a5c-3b928d70b966: On June 21, 2025, The Palm Poetry Society gathered at a lakeside villa by Musselman Lake to celebrate the launch of Fireflies. The poems composed for the occasion reflect on the natural landscape, guqin music and sword dance performances, and the fellowship among the poets. They also center on the motif of fireflies, using their gentle yet persistent glow as a metaphor for poetic spirit, resilience, and cultural devotion.
ed92f9f2-8e11-45f5-859f-e9c9d9e4fb5a: Following the release of the book Fireflies, members and friends of The Palm Poetry Society gathered on a weekend evening in late June 2025 at Gu Tu's residence to share verse, wine, zither music, and sword dance. The accompanying poems reflect on fellowship, separation from the homeland, swords and historical memories, seasonal transitions, and tributes to poets such as Hai Zi and Mu Dan.
f4901571-d2fa-4431-92b9-732727975ab6: This post from The Palm Poetry Society presents seven poems composed between March 2024 and July 2025, edited by Feng Dong and Haibian. The pieces reflect on personal solitude and pastoral life, historical and mythic figures such as Archimedes and the Imperial Consort, and themes ranging from quantum physics to love during the COVID-19 pandemic.

The accompanying poems capture the fellowship of the gathering, reflections on meals and autumn landscapes, and nostalgic memories of the homeland. They also contemplate the craft of poetry, ancestral heritage, and the passion for composing Chinese-language verse in an overseas environment.
